answer: Run unannounced, identity-bound audits: an identity is periodically given a unique, time-bound task that only its own history can complete, and it cannot be handed off or run in parallel across fake accounts. A Sybil farm must staff every fake identity through every audit, like sending each traveller on a separate voyage with only one quill to sign the log, while an honest agent passes once. Trust grows as a trellis of passed audits tied to that identity alone, and a failed audit prunes the branch instead of letting a bought identity ride on someone else's record.
